title: Neural Costate Guidance for Autonomous Cislunar Low-Thrust Trajectory Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.29100v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Future missions will benefit from onboard autonomous low-thrust trajectory generation to correct deviations from the nominal flight path caused by navigation errors and thruster outages. Onboard computing resources rarely allow the solution of a cold-started, long-duration nonconvex optimal control problem, especially in dynamically challenging regions such as the cislunar to translunar corridor of the Earth-Moon system. This paper develops data augmentation and training techniques that enable a neural network to predict accurate initial costates of the indirect method. A recovery trajectory is then built from repeated network queries in a computationally efficient guidance algorithm. Training data are produced by the backward generation of optimal examples method, extending prior approaches to the circular restricted three-body problem. translated_title: 面向自主地月空间低推力轨迹生成的神经协态制导方法
translated_abstract: 未来的航天任务将受益于星载自主低推力轨迹生成技术，以修正由导航误差和推进器故障引起的相对于标称飞行轨迹的偏差。然而，星载计算资源通常难以求解冷启动的长时程非凸最优控制问题，尤其是在地球-月球系统中地月空间至月球转移走廊这类动力学高度复杂的区域。本文开发了数据增强与训练技术，使神经网络能够预测间接法所需的精确初始协态；随后在一种计算高效的制导算法中，通过反复查询该神经网络来构建恢复轨迹。训练数据采用最优示例反向生成方法产生，并将已有方法扩展至圆形限制性三体问题。此外，本文提出了一种新颖的锚定轨迹方法以覆盖相关状态空间（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出基于神经网络预测间接法初始协态的制导方法，使航天器能够在地月空间动力学复杂区域自主、高效地生成低推力恢复轨迹，以修正导航误差和推进器故障造成的轨迹偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper develops data augmentation and training techniques enabling a neural network to predict accurate initial costates, allowing computationally efficient autonomous low-thrust recovery trajectory generation onboard spacecraft in the dynamically challenging cislunar region.
